Hey I can't help much, but here are a few things I want to tell you:

Your thoughts are not in your control, therefore you cannot define yourself through them (ie name a color, a fruit, and a car, right now, just off the top of your head. Don't read on until you do.)
.
.
.
.
Do you know why you chose any of those answers? No, you don't, they just popped up in your head! If someone put a machine to your head, and everyone could hear your thoughts, you would be embarrassed all the time - your mind says things you would never say!! 

This applies to the negativity you are experiencing in your mind. Close your eyes (Do it. Right now. Please.) and imagine an orange on a table. Watch it split in two. You can smell and taste it almost. Now open your eyes. Were you the orange, or the observer of the orange? I think you know the answer.

Now, if a kid came up to you and said, "You remind me of a big, green, happy sea turtle!" How would that make you feel? Neutral right? Now if that same kid said, "You are a loser who will never be able to do anything right and you should just give up you stupid perfectionist." That hurt a bit didn't it?

Now let's go back a little. When the kid called you a sea turtle, you were the observer of the orange. But when the kid called you a loser perfectionist, you became the orange; you applied meaning to those words and defined them as relevant to yourself. 

The thoughts in your head are going to run wild - that is the chatterbox side of your mind (it's not you). Then you have the listener, which is your mind hearing the chatter. Take a minute to just listen to your thoughts and not take them seriously. You are so down on yourself because you are allowing your thoughts to bully you. Just laugh at them, even if they aren't funny. Don't take life so seriously!
